device.description: 12-bit 2 MSPS dual simultaneous-sampling 2x2 fully- / 2x3 pseudo-differential SAR ADC with serial interface, SDI control word and programmable reference
device.note: ads7863a.pdf (SBAS610, ADS7863A) p.3 recommended operating conditions (BVDD 2.7-3.6 V / 4.5-5.5 V), p.4 electrical characteristics, p.5 Figure 2 Mode I timing, p.6 timing requirements, p.7 pin configurations and descriptions, p.16 SDI register (Tables 3-6), p.17 DAC register (Table 7), SDOx, Tables 8-9 (twos complement), p.18 Mode I, p.26 reference DAC programming and read-back, p.27 power-down modes and reset (Table 10)

registers.name: SDI
registers.note: p.16 Table 3 SDI register (default 000h); written through SDI with every RD access, no address

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: p.17 Table 7 reference DAC register (default 3FFh, bits 11-10 don't care)

registers.name: XFER
registers.note: internal state (not a datasheet register): DAC_WR=1 after an SDI word with P = 01, A = 001 (the next RD frame carries the DAC value, p.26 Figure 41); DAC_RD=1 after A = 011 (the next RD frame's SDI data are ignored, p.26)

commands.name: DAC value (second RD access after A = 001)
commands.note: p.26 Figure 41: the first two SDI bits are ignored, then the 10-bit DAC value MSB first

commands.name: DAC read-back frame (SDI ignored)
commands.note: p.26: during the second RD access the data on SDI are ignored

commands.name: Device reset (A = 101)
commands.note: p.27: an RD pulse with an SDI word holding A[2:0] = 101 resets the device at the 12th falling CLOCK edge

commands.name: DAC write with next access (P = 01, A = 001)
commands.in: cc 01 d n e r s 001
commands.note: p.16 Table 6, p.26: the next RD pulse's SDI word is the DAC value

commands.name: DAC read with next access (P = 01, A = 011)
commands.in: cc 01 d n e r s 011
commands.note: p.26: the next RD access sends '0000', the 10-bit DAC value and '00' on SDOA

commands.name: Update features, deep power-down (P = 01, DP = 1)
commands.in: cc 01 1 n e r s aaa

commands.name: Update features (P = 01)
commands.note: p.16 Table 5: P[1:0] = 01 updates DP, N, AN, RP, S4; DP = N = 0 leaves power-down

commands.name: Channel select, features not changed (P = 00/10/11)
commands.note: p.16 Tables 4-5: C[1:0] picks the input pair for the next conversion; P[1:0] other than 01 leaves the feature bits

pages: p.3 (ROC), p.4 (digital levels, BVDD), p.5 (Figure 2), p.6 (timing requirements t8 13 ns, t9 11 ns), p.7 (pins), p.16-17 (SDI and DAC registers, SDOx, Tables 8-9), p.18 (Mode I), p.26 (reference DAC), p.27 (power-down, reset)
notModeled: analog inputs, the 2:1 fully-differential / 3:1 pseudo-differential multiplexer (C[1:0]) and the reference DAC / REFOUT (never driven): every conversion returns the 0 V differential code 000h

SDOB (converter B in modes I/III) is never driven; SDOA shifts the Mode I 16-clock frame (0, 0, D11..D0, 0, 0). Modes II/IV (M1 = 1: A then B on SDOA), special read mode S4, automatic channel sequencing (M0 = 1) and the M0/M1 pins are not modeled

the serial frame is delimited by RD (the model's chip select: the frame starts when the RD pulse returns low, SDI is sampled on CLOCK falling edges and SDOA changes on CLOCK rising edges); the CS pin's gating of RD and the SDOx tri-state are not modeled, so keep CS low
DAC read-back (A = 011): channel A's result of the read-back frame is lost, as on the part (SDOA shifts the DAC value instead)

power-down: deep and NAP power-down are entered/left with the SDI word (P = 01) at once (the part: 13th clock, 2 us / 200 ns; wake-up 1 us / 3 clocks); a DAC-read word with DP or N set does not power down in the model; auto-NAP (AN), reference power-down (RP) are stored only

the conversion is clocked by the external CLOCK (16 cycles from the first CLOCK rising edge after CONVST rises, Figure 3); the model uses 16 x 31.25 ns = 500 ns at fCLOCK = 32 MHz; the channel is latched on the second CLOCK falling edge for the next conversion (model: the SDI.C value at the start)
vcc covers both BVDD ranges (2.7-3.6 V low-voltage and 4.5-5.5 V 5-V logic) as one range
pin names: the minus sign of CHxx- is written '-'
variants: ADS7863A (the orderable parts ADS7863ADBQR / ADS7863ARGET) is the device this spec describes; the original ADS7863 is not in the skeleton.
